reason: readFileSync with an empty encoding returns the same bytes as a Buffer, and the only reader, loadServerState, passes the result to JSON.parse, which decodes a Buffer as UTF-8; every server record parses to the same state.

The lookup gets this text only for a record with no platform. The production lookup, getStrategy, is keyed by platform ids, so neither the empty string nor any other non-id text has a strategy, and the refusal names the platform unknown either way.
